svg.title: Figure 3-17c. System FMEA failure modes: limits, configuration and the stock functions
svg.desc: Figure 3-17c: 8 System FMEA failure modes, limits, configuration and the stock functions. SFM-029 Actuator command limits not enforced (S 10; H-01, H-03, H-04). Effects: Out-of-limit steering or acceleration messages reach the vehicle / Loss of the main protection against F1/F2 faults on the device / Any upstream fault can produce SFM-002 / SFM-008 / SFM-009 effects ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration ; Contributes to HZ-006: Unintended or excessive deceleration. Causes: SFM-029.C1 Wrong safety model or parameter set for this car (O 3, D 4, M 7, AP L, MSR AP H); SFM-029.C2 Safety model limit defect in firmware (O 6, D 9, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-029.C3 Panda MCU hardware fault (see DFMEA/FMEDA) (O 3, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-029.C4 Harness allows the device to reach a bus without passing the panda filter (O 2, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP M). Actions: SFM-ACT-001 open, SFM-ACT-008 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-01 G-ENV; SG-03 G-LENV; SG-04 G-LENV. SFM-030 Excessive actuation not detected (S 10; H-01, H-03, H-04). Effects: excessiveActuation not raised / Item stays engaged during excessive motion / SFM-002/008/009 effects persist ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration ; Contributes to HZ-006: Unintended or excessive deceleration. Causes: SFM-030.C1 Calibrated pose wrong (calibration or IMU fault) (O 5, D 8, M -, AP H); SFM-030.C2 device_motion_valid gate blocks detection when aEgo and IMU disagree (O 6, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-002 open. Fault trees: SG-01 justified; SG-03 justified; SG-04 justified. SFM-031 False excessive-actuation detection (S 8; no hazard). Effects: excessiveActuation raised without excessive motion / Soft disable with alert / Unneeded handback to the driver. Causes: SFM-031.C1 IMU noise or bad mounting (O 5, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open. Fault trees: none. SFM-032 Wrong vehicle configuration active (fingerprint or car port) (S 10; H-01, H-03, H-04). Effects: CarParams, safety model and DBC for a different car / Wrong limits, scaling and message layout / Any F1/F2 effect; possible message conflicts with stock ECUs ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration ; Contributes to HZ-006: Unintended or excessive deceleration. Causes: SFM-032.C1 Fuzzy fingerprint matches a similar platform (O 4, D 9, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-008 in_progress. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-1.05; SG-03 BE-1.05; SG-04 justified. SFM-033 Stock safety functions unavailable or degraded while the item is installed (S 10; H-08). Effects: Stock ADAS camera messages blocked or replaced by the harness-box intercept / Stock AEB / FCW / lane assist not available as expected / Driver relies on stock protections that are not present. Causes: SFM-033.C1 The intercept routes the stock camera messages the vehicle needs for AEB through the panda (O 6, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-033.C2 Item does not forward or reproduce stock safety messages (O 5, D 3, M -, AP H); SFM-033.C3 The harness box loses its supply (ignition branch or D1 open without comma power, VIN shorted), or a switch channel opens, so the stock camera path through the unpowered or open DG419LE switches is cut (RR-2026-010) (O 5, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-006 open. Fault trees: SG-07 G7.1. SFM-034 Harness-box intercept switch stuck or in the wrong position (S 10; H-08, H-01, H-04, H-03). Effects: Intercept switch stuck or intermittent: in intercept when released (camera cut off from the car), or in pass-through when driven (stock camera and item both on the bus) / Conflicting steering/ACC messages, or no camera messages / Erratic stock or item behavior; stock functions lost ; Contributes to HZ-002: stock LKA and item steering requests combine on the bus ; Contributes to HZ-006: stock and item braking requests combine on the bus ; Contributes to HZ-005: stock ACC and item acceleration requests combine on the bus. Causes: SFM-034.C1 Switch U1 or U2 stuck in intercept, its IN input damaged high or driven high, its pull-down R2/R3 open, or the switches damaged by box supply transients (DG419LE, RR-2026-010) (O 4, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-034.C2 Switch stuck in pass-through, or the SBU1 drive lost, held low or too low to change the switch over (5 V drive against VL = VIN) (O 3, D 9, M -, AP H). Actions: none. Fault trees: SG-01 BE-4.19, G1.4; SG-03 BE-4.19; SG-04 BE-4.19, G4.8; SG-07 BE-7.09, G7.3. SFM-035 Item sends a frame that alters the stock pre-collision function (S 10; H-08, H-04). Effects: A PCS-relevant frame from the SoC (0x344 PRE_COLLISION_2, 0x411 PCS_HUD, a DSU-only ID, or 0x283 PRE_COLLISION with a non-zero payload) reaches the car bus / Stock PCS warning or braking suppressed, altered or triggered by the item / Stock AEB/FCW degraded while the driver relies on it ; Contributes to HZ-006: PCS braking triggered by a frame from the item. Causes: SFM-035.C1 Host code (car interface, pandad) emits a PCS-relevant ID or a non-zero PRE_COLLISION payload (QM fault) (O 6, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-035.C3 The TX whitelist or the PRE_COLLISION content check lets a PCS-relevant frame through (table change, or a build that is not the reference build, where 0x411 is allowed by design) (O 5, D 3, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: none. Fault trees: SG-04 tree gap; SG-07 BE-7.08. SFM-036 Item keeps requesting acceleration while stock PCS brakes (S 10; H-08). Effects: ACC_CONTROL keeps carrying the planner's acceleration request while the stock camera reports a PCS braking event / PCS braking depends on the PCM giving it priority over the item's request (AOU-04R, unverified) / Stock AEB deceleration reduced or delayed if the PCM arbitrates otherwise. Causes: SFM-036.C1 The item has no reaction to a stock PCS event on its longitudinal command; controlsd keeps requesting the planner's acceleration (design gap, FTA BE-7.13) (O 8, D 10, M 8, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-036.C2 The PCM does not give stock PCS braking priority over the item's ACC_CONTROL request (AOU-04R not met) (O 3, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-006 open, SFM-ACT-020 completed, not yet credited. Fault trees: SG-07 BE-7.13 (single point).
